findings.event: FDA accelerated approval of Rybrevant Faspro for recurrent/metastatic HNSCC
findings.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval for subcutaneous amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj (Rybrevant Faspro, ENHANZE-enabled) in recurrent/metastatic HNSCC post-platinum/anti-PD-(L)1, converting the already-tracked Priority Review into an approval and the first Rybrevant Faspro indication outside EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
findings.summary_ko: FDA는 피하 아미반타맙+히알루로니다제-lpuj(Rybrevant Faspro, ENHANZE 기반)에 대해 백금/항PD-(L)1 치료 후 진행된 재발성·전이성 HNSCC에 신속승인을 부여했다. 이는 이미 추적 중인 우선심사가 승인으로 전환된 것이며, EGFR 변이 비소세포폐암 이외로는 Rybrevant Faspro의 첫 적응증이다.

findings.event: Global non-exclusive ENHANZE license for subcutaneous petosemtamab
findings.source_name: PR Newswire (Merus N.V. / Halozyme joint release)
findings.summary: Merus licensed ENHANZE (rHuPH20) from Halozyme to develop a subcutaneous formulation of its EGFR x LGR5 bispecific petosemtamab; undisclosed upfront plus milestones and low-to-mid single-digit royalties. Closes a completeness gap in the ENHANZE licensee list.
findings.summary_ko: Merus는 할로자임의 ENHANZE(rHuPH20)를 라이선스하여 EGFR x LGR5 이중특이항체 petosemtamab의 피하 제형을 개발하기로 했다; 비공개 선급금과 마일스톤, 저~중간 단일 숫자 로열티 조건이다. ENHANZE 라이선시 목록의 완전성 공백을 메운다.

tier5_assessment: Tier 5 (queries 18-22) surfaced nothing this run -- all five regulator list/calendar checks came back unconfirmed/not-yet-indexed for November 2026. The one real finding (Rybrevant Faspro HNSCC approval) was caught by the Tier-1/2 name-search sweep instead, one cycle after the event (J&J's own release was published ~Nov 5, found during this Nov 9 run) -- Tier 5's FDA-approvals-list query specifically did not catch it, since that list had not yet been updated for the new approval at check time. This is a near-miss of the same shape as the original Kiject incident, just caught sooner via Tier 1/2 rather than via Tier 5 as intended.
fetch_failures_non_block: fda.gov direct press-announcement URLs returned 404 on guessed slugs (wrong slug, not a block) -- worked around via J&J's own primary release
contractpharma.com and americanpharmaceuticalreview.com returned 403 to WebFetch (likely bot-protection, not on the known block list) -- worked around via corroborating outlets per 1.3.1 rung 5
dart_fallback_ladder_used: Not invoked this run -- no Korean disclosure item required it (no DART-specific filing surfaced).
notes: Korean trade press (mt.co.kr, dailypharm, biospectator, hankyung) surfaced the same InventageLab/G2GBio/Alteogen/Celltrion items EN sources did this run; no material EN/KO divergence. 27 total queries run (22-query fixed matrix + 5 supplementary verification queries for date/corroboration checks).
